all-creatures-great-and-small.why: Two late seasons only (5, 6); playlists in reverse episode order; varied runtimes.

breaking-bad.why: Clean reference: five seasons, in order, distinct runtimes.

star-trek-deep-space-nine.why: DVD, seven seasons, runtimes identical within a season: runtime alone cannot place a title.

supernatural.why: Fourteen seasons on disc (2 to 15): beyond the ten-season scan cap.

doctor-who-2005.why: Specials (season 0), three releases of the same episodes (Blu-ray and UHD), shuffled playlists.

futurama.why: One volume whose playlists are shuffled against episode order with uniform runtimes.

sherlock.why: Ninety-minute episodes: a TV disc that looks like a movie.

the-simpsons.why: Deep seasons: 38 TMDb seasons, so a wrong season guess has many candidates.

doctor-who-1963.why: Deep seasons: 26 TMDb seasons of classic serials with uneven episode counts.
